## About

This repository contains the official container images for Arc Jumpstart products. Source code for all containers is available at [Jumpstart Apps GitHub](https://github.com/Azure/jumpstart-apps/).

### What is Arc Jumpstart?

Azure Arc Jumpstart is a set of curated tools, guides, and scenarios designed to help users quickly and easily deploy Azure Arc services across various environments, including on-premises, multi-cloud, and edge locations.

### Jumpstart Products

- **Jumpstart Agora**: A marketplace of various “cloud to edge” industry scenarios, designed to provide an end-to-end user experience.
- **Jumpstart HCIBox**: A hands-on, self-contained environment that simulates Azure Stack HCI infrastructure, providing users with a lab experience to explore Azure Arc integration.
- **Jumpstart ArcBox**: A comprehensive sandbox environment that deploys an end-to-end Azure Arc lab with pre-configured resources for testing and learning.
- **Jumpstart Sceanrios**: A collection of real-world Azure Arc use cases and tutorials designed to guide users through various deployment, management, and operational tasks with Azure Arc-enabled services.
- **Jumpstart Drops**: A curated collection of scripts, tools, and other assets that can help developers/IT/OT and Day-2 Operations professionals streamline their day-to-day operations and smooth their Adaptive cloud journey.​ *Important: We do not host Drops containers in MCR*.

## Usage

To use these products, please refer to the official Arc Jumpstart documentation:

- [Jumpstart Agora Documentation](https://arcjumpstart.com/azure_jumpstart_ag)
- [Jumpstart HCIBox Documentation](https://arcjumpstart.com/azure_jumpstart_hcibox)
- [Jumpstart ArcBox Documentation](https://arcjumpstart.com/azure_jumpstart_arcbox)
- [Jumpstart Scenarios Documentation](https://arcjumpstart.com/azure_arc_jumpstart)
- [Jumpstart Drops Documentation](https://arcjumpstart.com/azure_jumpstart_drops)
